titre: Practice test — English (5th year primary) — Term 3

exercices.enonce:
Reading - Comprehension
Read the text then answer the questions.

Every Thursday, my grandmother goes to the market in our town. She takes a big basket. She buys onions, carrots and potatoes. She also buys eggs and cheese. The market is near the school and the post office. My grandmother pays the seller and then we go to the park to rest. I love going to the market with her.

Questions:
1) When does the grandmother go to the market? (1 pt)
2) What vegetables does she buy? (2 pts)
3) What else does she buy? (1 pt)
4) Where is the market? (1 pt)
5) Where do they go after the market? (1 pt)

Food - Classify
Write fruit or vegetable:
a) onion ← ...
b) orange ← ...
c) potato ← ...
d) grape ← ...
